title: PendingRequest carries a bag of optional correlation fields (scope, forum_topic_id, user_id, supergroup_id, community_id, story_id, story_ids, story_album_id, user_ids, around_message_id, window_epoch) whose meaning depends on the purpose and is kept in step by the request_for_* helpers
trigger: any answer whose handler reads a field its builder did not set (for example around_message_id read as GetHistory's from_message_id and as GetGameHighScores' message)
effect: a handler that forgets the purpose check reads None or another request's meaning; the apply arms silently skip
fix: the correlation data lives inside RequestPurpose variants (purpose-specific payload) instead of side Options

title: ChatSearchJump::Loading { message_id, then } names the target but holds no RequestId; finish_history_around matches the answer by message id (jump_serial is a second hand-bumped counter beside the stage)
trigger: jump to a message, jump to another, jump back to the first while the first around-page is still out
effect: the first request's answer (same message id) settles the second jump, or lands as stale; no way to tell the asks apart

title: take_sponsored_views marks ads viewed before viewMessages goes out; only a failed send untakes them, a TDLib error answer or a swept request leaves them marked
trigger: an ad shows while the connection is flaky or TDLib answers the viewMessages with an error (flood wait, 500) or the request is swept stale
effect: the ad stays in ChatSponsoredMessages::viewed, never sent again until the list is refetched after five minutes and dropped; the impression is not counted
fix: viewed ids held in a stage keyed by the ViewSponsoredMessages RequestId, released on error and lost-request settlement (no arm for RequestPurpose::ViewSponsoredMessages exists in the error or lost-request paths)

title: Translation::Pending holds a hand-made job number (TranslateState::next_job) instead of the RequestId; fail_orphaned_translations finds orphans by has_purpose(TranslateJob{job})
trigger: translate a chat's messages while requests are swept or dropped
effect: two numbering schemes (job and request) must stay in step; an orphan is detected by scanning the registry by purpose each pass
fix: Translation::Pending { request: RequestId, attempts } settled and cancelled by the request

title: one-shot answer slots write_access and phone_share are Option fields overwritten by the next answer; the first answer is lost if its taker has not drained it
trigger: two mini apps (two windows, or one app asking twice) ask canSendMessages / sharePhone and both answers land before the UI poll drains the slot
effect: the first mini app never gets its WriteAnswer or PhoneShare and waits on its request forever (the other one-shot queues are Vecs and keep both)
fix: a Vec<WriteAnswer> / map keyed by RequestId taken by the asker, like emoji_access and data_sent

title: SharedMediaTabStatus::Loading and NextPage::Loading hold no RequestId; the tab's request is told apart by SharedMediaTabState::generation and SharedMediaState::generation, a second counter beside the stage that the first-page, older-page and search paths restamp by hand
trigger: open the gallery, search in Files, switch tab, calendar-jump, scroll to older pages
effect: answers are trusted when a counter matches; the first-page and the older-page request of a tab share one stamp, so a duplicate older page for the same stamp is not distinguishable
fix: Loading { request: RequestId } and NextPage::Loading { request } compared on answer

title: GraphFetch::Loading is a bare in-flight stage; its request lives in a second map StatsState::graph_requests that must be kept in step by graph_requested / accept_graph / fail_graph
trigger: open statistics, zoom a graph, then leave the panel or hit a swept request
effect: a graph can read Loading with no entry in graph_requests (answer dropped silently), or an entry whose graph key was replaced
fix: GraphFetch::Loading { request: RequestId } and no side map

title: MessageStatsFetch defaults to Loading(None) (an Option used as the 'not sent yet' flag); fetch_message_statistics returns early on has_purpose(GetMessageStatistics) without recording the in-flight request id, so the in-flight answer matches nothing
trigger: open statistics of channel post A (request out), open post B (begin_message replaces the state), return to A before A's answer lands
effect: A's state is a fresh Loading(None); the early return leaves it so; A's answer fails waits_for(Some(id)) and is dropped; the page spins until the panel is reopened (the next call then sends a fresh request)
fix: adopt the registry's in-flight request id into Loading { request } instead of deduping by purpose, or hold MessageStatsFetch::Idle until a request id exists

title: PageFetch::Loading(None), StoryStatsFetch::Loading(None) and MessageStatsFetch::Loading(None) use an Option<RequestId> as the 'asked but not sent' flag; the stage is Loading with no request until a second call fills it
trigger: begin_story_search / story_search_page_requested / begin_story_insights then the send is skipped (locked, chats path inactive)
effect: a Loading with no request has no way out except a send call that may never come; an answer cannot be matched until the Some is written
fix: Idle until the request id exists; Loading { request: RequestId } written together with the registry entry

title: ThreadStatus::Resolving holds no RequestId; getMessageThread's answer is matched by origin chat and origin message id, and SwitchingChat/Starting/ReloadNeeded are driver-polled hand-off stages with no owner of the next step
trigger: open the same comment thread twice, or open it, close it, reopen it before the first answer
effect: an earlier getMessageThread answer for the same origin message resolves the newer view (apply_message_thread_info compares ids, not requests); the three hand-off stages rely on the UI poll to advance and have no timeout
fix: Resolving { request: RequestId } compared in apply_message_thread_info and fail_thread

title: deep-link stages are matched by a hand-bumped generation counter, not the RequestId held in the stage
trigger: Click two deep links in a row; the first link's late answer arrives after the second started
effect: No bug traced today: stale answers are dropped by comparing ChatsPurpose::DeepLink*{generation} to DeepLinkState::*::generation, a u64 from ChatsState::next_deep_link_generation, instead of the stage holding its RequestId (fetch.waits_for). Same 'counter to tell old answers from current' shape the state-machines doc names; every stage variant and every error arm must remember to compare it.
fix: DeepLinkState::Resolving{request: RequestId} variants compared with the answer's RequestId; delete deep_link_seq

title: baseline: GiveawaySummary::finished is a start/results variant held as a bool
effect: `finished` is set true by parse_results and false by parse_start (the two constructors); nothing outside the envelope tests reads it, so it is a dead stage flag. The 'results' card also carries `info_message_id`/`unclaimed_count`/`was_refunded` that mean nothing for a start card.
fix: enum GiveawaySummary{Started{..}, Results{info_message_id, unclaimed, refunded, ..}}; delete `finished`

title: baseline: ParsedSession::is_password_pending bool
trigger: none (TDLib session.is_password_pending mirrored as is; the session list splits rows by it)
fix: allow-list as a server fact or fold into a SessionKind enum with is_current/is_unconfirmed
